source: OpenStreetMap admin_level=8 commune relations and their admin_centre nodes, via Overpass, each node re-read from the OpenStreetMap node API; plus one coordinate read off a map by the project owner (see the row's owner_verified block), which is not OpenStreetMap-derived
method: Wilaya capital (chef-lieu) communes only, and a different standard from the two earlier batches, because containment cannot see this class: all five stored centres are INSIDE their own commune, 3 to 6 km from the town. A row qualifies when it is a wilaya capital commune, its stored centre is more than 3 km from its relation's admin_centre node, and claims this correction is not derived from put the town at the node rather than at the stored centre: the wilaya's own published point (from its admin_level=4 relation, a different OpenStreetMap object) is nearer the node, and so is the geometric median of the geo_precision: exact records other packages place inside this commune's own OpenStreetMap outline, selected by point-in-polygon rather than by the commune they name. Over all 69 capitals that two-claim criterion selects exactly four, and the fifth row here is NOT one of them. Beni-Abbes (5201) is the only other capital more than 3 km from its node, and the wilaya-point leg argues against it: wilaya 52's own capital point is 6.7 km from the stored centre and 8.5 km from the town, because that point is itself about 8.5 km out, which is #228 to fix. So Beni-Abbes carries `decided_by: "owner_verified"`: the Owner read its town centre off the map on 2026-10-01 and that point is what is written, cross-checked twice, against the facility median (210 m, against 5,628 m for the stored centre) and against the commune's own admin_centre node (268 m, inside the 500 m at which two hands stop reading the same place). Its coordinate is therefore NOT OpenStreetMap-derived and is not counted in the ODbL carve-out; its relation, 6530989, also carries the pre-reform ref:ONS 0807. For the four node-decided rows `to` is that node rounded to 6 decimals, re-read from api.openstreetmap.org on 2026-10-01; every row records the node coordinate in `osm.admin_centre_point` so any of them can be re-checked offline. A seat delta on its own is NOT a defect (the Owner's 2026-09-29 decision, private tracker #170): 132 non-capital centres stay more than 3 km from their seat, measured against osm-seat-reference.json after this batch, and none of them is corrected here; after this batch Beni-Abbes is no longer the one capital left in that band either. Applied by scripts/fix-commune-centres.mjs; held by test/capital-centre-near-seat.test.mjs.

owner_verified.evidence: The town centre of Beni-Abbes read off the map by the project owner and supplied as 30.1310763, -2.1663499, rounded here to the 6 decimals this package carries. Same convention as the owner_verified coordinates in quality/overrides/sante.json, reviewed 2026-09-30: a point a human read off a map, recorded as such and never presented as OpenStreetMap-derived.
owner_verified.licence: Not OpenStreetMap-derived. This coordinate carries the package's MIT compilation terms, not ODbL, and is deliberately NOT counted among the OpenStreetMap-derived commune centres in LICENSE, NOTICE and dataset-metadata.json.

osm.note: Compared against, not written. The relation carries the PRE-REFORM ref:ONS 0807 (Bechar), so this row joined on that code plus the name inside the mother wilaya rather than on 5201 directly.

evidence.wilaya_point_note: The only one of the five where the wilaya-point claim argues AGAINST the move: wilaya 52's own capital point is itself about 8.5 km from its capital's town centre, which is yasserstudio/geoalgeria.com#228 to fix and not this batch. So this row is NOT selected by the two-claim criterion the other four meet, and it is decided by the Owner's point instead, cross-checked against the facility median and the admin_centre node.
